record.paper_title: Open Questions in Charm Decays Deserving an Answer
record.original_question: What are the leptonic decay rates D^+ -> mu^+ nu, D^+ -> tau^+ nu, D_s^+ -> mu^+ nu, and D_s^+ -> tau^+ nu, and therefore the decay constants f_D and f_Ds, with enough precision to determine whether they are near the expected 200 MeV scale and whether the ratio f_Ds/f_D is about 1.15-1.2?

evidence.quote: An observation of D+, D+ s → µ+ν, τ +ν will allow a reliable extraction of the values for the decay constants fD and fDs .
A battery of theoretical estimates cluster around [4] fD ∼ 200 ± 30 MeV, fDs ∼ 200 ± 30 MeV, fDs /fD ≃ 1.15 − 1.2 (4)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the charmed pseudoscalar mesons $D^+$ (quark content $c\bar d$) and $D_s^+$ (quark content $c\bar s$). For a pseudoscalar meson $P=Q\bar q$ of mass $m_P$ composed of a heavy quark $Q$ and light antiquark $\bar q$, define the decay constant $f_P$ via the matrix element
$$\langle 0 | \bar q \gamma^\mu \gamma_5 Q | P(p)\rangle = i f_P\, p^\mu.$$
In the Standard Model the purely leptonic decay rate of such a meson into a charged lepton $\ell$ plus its neutrino is
$$\Gamma(P\to \ell^+\nu_\ell) = \frac{G_F^2}{8\pi} f_P^2\, m_\ell^2\, m_P\left(1-\frac{m_\ell^2}{m_P^2}\right)^{\!2}|V_{Qq}|^2,$$
where $G_F$ is the Fermi constant and $V_{Qq}$ is the relevant CKM matrix element ($V_{cd}$ for $D^+$, $V_{cs}$ for $D_s^+$).

Determine, with sufficient precision, the leptonic branching fractions / decay rates of
$$D^+\to \mu^+\nu_\mu,\quad D^+\to \tau^+\nu_\tau,\quad D_s^+\to \mu^+\nu_\mu,\quad D_s^+\to \tau^+\nu_\tau,$$
and hence extract the decay constants $f_D$ and $f_{D_s}$ and their ratio $f_{D_s}/f_D$. In particular, decide:

(a) whether $f_D$ and $f_{D_s}$ lie near the $200$ MeV scale (specifically, are consistent with $200\pm 30$ MeV);

(b) whether the ratio $f_{D_s}/f_D$ lies in the range $1.15$–$1.20$.
artifact.status_search_result: All four leptonic decays have been observed and the decay constants measured with good precision by CLEO-c, BaBar, Belle and BES. Current world averages give f_D ≈ 212 MeV and f_{D_s} ≈ 250 MeV, with f_{D_s}/f_D ≈ 1.17–1.24, in agreement with modern lattice QCD calculations (e.g. f_D = 197(9) MeV, f_{D_s} = 244(8) MeV, ratio 1.24(3)). The values are near the 200 MeV scale and the ratio is at or slightly above the originally anticipated 1.15–1.20 range.

status_evidence.title: Measurement of the Decay Constant f_{D_s+} using D_s+ -> l+ nu (CLEO)
status_evidence.snippet: CLEO-c measurement extracted fDs+ = 274 ± 13 ± 7 MeV and fDs+/fD+ = 1.23 ± 0.11 ± 0.04.
status_evidence.claim: Leptonic D_s decays have been observed and f_{D_s} and the ratio f_{D_s}/f_D have been measured.

status_evidence.title: Pseudoscalar decay constants of kaon and D-mesons from Nf=2 twisted mass Lattice QCD
status_evidence.snippet: fD = 197(9) MeV, fDs = 244(8) MeV and fDs/fD = 1.24(3).
status_evidence.claim: Lattice QCD provides precise values for f_D, f_{D_s} and their ratio, near the 200 MeV scale.

status_evidence.title: Improved Measurement of the Pseudoscalar Decay Constant f_{D_s}
status_evidence.snippet: CLEO II measurement yielded fDs = (280 ± 19 ± 28 ± 34) MeV.
status_evidence.claim: Experimental measurements of f_{D_s} were achieved already in the late 1990s and have since been refined.
